mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_file nf INNER JOIN sys_notice n ON n.notice_id = nf.notice_id WHERE nf.file_id = #{fileId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 )
SELECT avatar FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (avatar LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fileNamePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR avatar LIKE '%!%%' ESCAPE '!')

SELECT notice_content FROM sys_notice WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (notice_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fileNamePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR notice_content LIKE '%!%%' ESCAPE '!' OR notice_content LIKE '%&%')
